caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object with a box-like base and curved side panels, featuring a central rotating bar or spindle supported by two curved arms extending upward from the sides. The main body of the object is rectangular, with the top open, and is fastened together with several visible screws or wooden pegs along the sides. The wood appears to be a light to medium brown color with visible grain. Inside the box, there is a horizontal platform or shelf partway down, and a section underneath that appears to be covered with a piece of beige or light-colored fabric. The overall construction is symmetrical, with the ends of the arms and the bottom legs slightly tapering. The background of the image is a plain, light beige color, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner reading "Richard Taylor."
title: Flour Sifter
